modifier.kubejs.knife_handling.descripti: Greatly reduces knockback so mobs stay in reach, like a kitchen knife
material.kubejs.skyroot.flavor: Grown on islands in the sky.
material.kubejs.skyroot.encyclopedia: Tools: blocks naturally generated in the Aether with double drops drop twice (not with Silk Touch). Swords, daggers and cleavers: at full attack strength, mob drops are doubled (not from players, withers or ender dragons).
material.kubejs.holystone.encyclopedia: Tools: 1 in 50 chance for an ambrosium shard when breaking a block. Swords, daggers and cleavers: 1 in 25 chance at full attack strength to drop an ambrosium shard from the target.
material.kubejs.zanite.flavor: The more worn it is, the harder it bites.
material.kubejs.zanite.encyclopedia: Mining speed is multiplied by 0.5 to 2.5 as durability drops. Swords, daggers and cleavers deal extra damage once under 75% durability, up to 2.5 times at 0%.
material.kubejs.gravitite.encyclopedia: Tools: right-click a block to make it float, costing 4 durability. Swords, daggers and cleavers: at full attack strength, hitting a grounded or swimming target launches it upward.
modifier.kubejs.skyroot_bounty.descripti: Tools: blocks naturally generated in the Aether with double drops drop twice (not with Silk Touch). Swords, daggers and cleavers: at full attack strength, mob drops are doubled (not from players, withers or ender dragons).
modifier.kubejs.holystone_blessing.descr: Tools: 1 in 50 chance for an ambrosium shard when breaking a block. Swords, daggers and cleavers: 1 in 25 chance at full attack strength to drop an ambrosium shard from the target.
modifier.kubejs.zanite_fervor.flavor: The more worn it is, the harder it bites.
modifier.kubejs.zanite_fervor.descriptio: Mining speed is multiplied by 0.5 to 2.5 as durability drops. Swords, daggers and cleavers deal extra damage once under 75% durability, up to 2.5 times at 0%.
modifier.kubejs.gravitite_lift.descripti: Tools: right-click a block to make it float, costing 4 durability. Swords, daggers and cleavers: at full attack strength, hitting a grounded or swimming target launches it upward.
material.kubejs.certus_quartz.encycloped: AE2 certus quartz tools are plain iron-tier tools with no special ability.
material.kubejs.fluix.flavor: Crystal clear, in a purple sort of way.
material.kubejs.fluix.encyclopedia: Head grants Fortune I on harvesting tools and Looting I on melee weapons, like AE2 fluix tools.
material.kubejs.dragonbone.encyclopedia: Plain Ice and Fire dragonbone tools have no special ability, only their tier.
material.kubejs.myrmex_desert_chitin.enc: Hits deal extra damage to non-arthropods, and again to death worms.
material.kubejs.myrmex_jungle_chitin.enc: Hits deal extra damage to non-arthropods, and again to death worms.
material.kubejs.dragonsteel_lightning.en: Strikes targets with lightning and knocks them back.
modifier.kubejs.myrmex_chitin.descriptio: Melee hits deal an extra hit of weapon damage plus 5 to anything that is not an arthropod, and a second one to death worms.
modifier.kubejs.dragonbone_flame.descrip: Swords: ignites targets for 5 seconds and knocks them back. Deals an extra 13.5 fire damage to ice dragons.
modifier.kubejs.dragonbone_frost.descrip: Swords: freezes targets for 10 seconds with Slowness III and Weakness III for 5 seconds, and knocks them back. Deals an extra 13.5 freezing damage to fire dragons.
modifier.kubejs.dragonbone_bolt.descript: Swords: strikes targets with lightning and knocks them back. Deals an extra 9.5 lightning damage to fire and ice dragons.
modifier.kubejs.dragonsteel_flame.descri: Melee hits ignite targets for 15 seconds and knock them back.
modifier.kubejs.dragonsteel_frost.descri: Melee hits freeze targets for 15 seconds, apply Slowness III for 15 seconds and knock them back.
modifier.kubejs.dragonsteel_bolt.descrip: Melee hits strike targets with lightning and knock them back.
material.kubejs.valkyrie.encyclopedia: Extends block and attack reach by 3.5 in the main hand. Loot only: no repair item.
modifier.kubejs.valkyrie_reach.descripti: Grants +3.5 block reach and +3.5 attack range while held in the main hand.
material.kubejs.aether_candy_cane.encycl: At full attack strength, 50% chance to drop a candy cane from the target (not players).
At full attack strength, 50% chance to drop a candy cane from the target (not players).
material.kubejs.aether_flaming.encyclope: At full attack strength, sets targets on fire for 30 seconds (+4 per Fire Aspect level).
modifier.kubejs.aether_flaming_blade.des: At full attack strength, sets targets on fire for 30 seconds (+4 per Fire Aspect level).
material.kubejs.aether_holy.encyclopedia: At full strength vs undead: +8.25 damage and 10 extra durability lost per hit.
modifier.kubejs.aether_holy_smite.descri: At full strength vs undead: +8.25 damage and 10 extra durability lost per hit.
material.kubejs.aether_lightning.encyclo: At full attack strength, strikes the target with lightning.
At full attack strength, strikes the target with lightning.
material.kubejs.aether_vampire.encyclope: At full attack strength, heals the wielder by half a heart per hit when hurt.
modifier.kubejs.aether_vampiric.descript: At full attack strength, heals the wielder by half a heart per hit when hurt.
material.kubejs.aether_pig_slayer.flavor: Not a friend of the farmer.
material.kubejs.aether_pig_slayer.encycl: At full attack strength, +16 damage against pigs, piglins, hoglins and zoglins.
modifier.kubejs.aether_pig_bane.flavor: Not a friend of the farmer.
modifier.kubejs.aether_pig_bane.descript: At full attack strength, +16 damage against pigs, piglins, hoglins and zoglins.
material.kubejs.aether_hammer_of_kingbdo: Right-click to throw a hammer projectile (2.5 second cooldown, costs 1 durability).
modifier.kubejs.aether_hammer_throw.desc: Right-click to throw a hammer projectile (2.5 second cooldown, costs 1 durability). Swings much faster than a normal sledge hammer (+0.85 attack speed).
material.kubejs.tf_giant.flavor: Made for hands far too large.
material.kubejs.tf_giant.encyclopedia: Slow swings, +2.5 reach, and 64 times mining speed against giant blocks.
modifier.kubejs.tf_giant_might.flavor: Made for hands far too large.
modifier.kubejs.tf_giant_might.descripti: Slow swings, +2.5 reach, and 64 times mining speed against giant blocks.
material.kubejs.tf_glass.encyclopedia: Deals 36 damage but only lasts a single hit.
material.kubejs.tf_ice.encyclopedia: Hits apply Frosty II for 10 seconds to targets that can be frozen. As bow limbs: shoots Twilight Forest ice arrows.
modifier.kubejs.tf_ice_chill.description: Hits apply Frosty II for 10 seconds to targets that can be frozen.
material.kubejs.tf_mazebreaker.encyclope: Mining speed is multiplied by 16 on maze stone and castle blocks.
modifier.kubejs.tf_mazebreaker_speed.des: Mining speed is multiplied by 16 on maze stone and castle blocks.
material.kubejs.iaf_hippogryph.encyclope: Every hit also slashes nearby enemies for sweep damage and knocks them back.
modifier.kubejs.iaf_hippogryph_slash.des: Every hit also slashes nearby enemies for sweep damage and knocks them back.
material.kubejs.iaf_stymphalian.encyclop: No special ability besides its tier; the original is a very fast dagger.
material.kubejs.iaf_amphithere.encyclope: Hits throw the target up and back. Original also disables shields.
modifier.kubejs.iaf_amphithere_gust.desc: Hits throw the target up and back. Original also disables shields.
material.kubejs.iaf_ghost.encyclopedia: Swing in the air (right-click here) to fire a spinning sword that passes through blocks.
modifier.kubejs.iaf_ghost_blade.descript: Swing in the air (right-click here) to fire a spinning sword that passes through blocks.
material.kubejs.iaf_dread_thrall.encyclo: No special ability besides its tier.
material.kubejs.iaf_dread_knight.encyclo: No special ability besides its tier.
material.kubejs.iaf_dread_queen.encyclop: No special ability besides its tier.
material.kubejs.iaf_troll.encyclopedia: No special ability besides its tier.
material.kubejs.na_infused_iron.encyclop: Botanist tools: pickaxe mossifies stone, blade slows targets (Slowness III, 3 s), handaxe breaks leaves at full tool speed.
modifier.kubejs.na_botanist.description: Botanist tools: pickaxe mossifies stone, blade slows targets (Slowness III, 3 s), handaxe breaks leaves at full tool speed.
material.kubejs.na_sky.flavor: A taste of the Gods' power.
material.kubejs.na_sky.encyclopedia: Skyseeker tools: pickaxe sends mined drops to your inventory, sneak-use toggles the handaxe small-tree felling, blade levitates targets (3 s).
modifier.kubejs.na_skyseeker.flavor: A taste of the Gods' power.
modifier.kubejs.na_skyseeker.description: Skyseeker tools: pickaxe sends mined drops to your inventory, sneak-use toggles the handaxe small-tree felling, blade levitates targets (3 s).
material.kubejs.na_depth.flavor: Forged from sky, earth and depths.
material.kubejs.na_depth.encyclopedia: Soulstrider tools: sneak-use toggles pickaxe ore-vein mining and handaxe whole-tree felling, blade sweeps a wide area.
modifier.kubejs.na_soulstrider.flavor: Forged from sky, earth and depths.
modifier.kubejs.na_soulstrider.descripti: Soulstrider tools: sneak-use toggles pickaxe ore-vein mining and handaxe whole-tree felling, blade sweeps a wide area.
material.kubejs.gold.encyclopedia: Vanilla golden tool tier: very fast but fragile. No special ability.
material.kubejs.aether_neptune.encyclope: Armor only. Full set (with gloves): faster swimming. Loot only.
material.kubejs.aether_phoenix.encyclope: Armor: full set (with gloves) grants fire immunity. Bow limbs: arrows set targets on fire. Loot only.
material.kubejs.aether_obsidian.encyclop: Armor only. High toughness, no special ability. Loot only.
material.kubejs.aether_sentry.encycloped: Boots only: no fall damage. Loot only.
material.kubejs.tf_naga.flavor: Shed by a serpent of the Twilight.
material.kubejs.tf_yeti.encyclopedia: Armor only. Attackers are chilled (Frosty); boots walk on powder snow.
material.kubejs.tf_arctic.encyclopedia: Armor only. Boots walk on powder snow.
material.kubejs.tf_phantom.encyclopedia: Armor only. Soulbound: kept on death. Loot only.
material.kubejs.iaf_dragon_scale.encyclo: Armor only. Takes less damage from dragon breath (fire, ice, lightning).
material.kubejs.iaf_tide.encyclopedia: Armor only. Water breathing; Strength while wet, stronger per piece worn.
modifier.kubejs.troll_hide.description: Takes less projectile damage: 10% helmet, 30% chestplate, 20% leggings, 10% boots (as Ice and Fire troll leather).
modifier.kubejs.dragon_ward.description: Takes less damage from dragon breath (fire, ice, lightning): 10% helmet, 30% chestplate, 20% leggings, 10% boots.
modifier.kubejs.set_gravitite.descriptio: Full set with Gravitite Gloves: jumps launch you much higher, and fall damage is negated.
modifier.kubejs.set_valkyrie.description: Full set with Valkyrie Gloves: fall damage is negated. The glide flight of the original set is not reproduced.
modifier.kubejs.set_neptune.description: Full set with Neptune Gloves: much faster swimming.
modifier.kubejs.set_phoenix.description: Full set with Phoenix Gloves: immune to fire and lava damage. The lava swimming boost and turning to obsidian when wet are not reproduced.
modifier.kubejs.tide_attuned.description: Water breathing while worn. While wet, melee attacks deal +3 damage per Tide piece worn (Strength I to IV).
modifier.kubejs.tf_yeti_chill.descriptio: Attackers are chilled (Frosty) for a few seconds, longer with more Yeti pieces.
material.kubejs.tf_ender.encyclopedia: Bow limbs only: an arrow that hits a living target swaps places with it. Loot only.
material.kubejs.tf_seeker.encyclopedia: Bow limbs only: arrows home in on nearby targets but deal half damage. Loot only.
material.kubejs.tf_triple.encyclopedia: Bow limbs only: fires two extra arrows above and below (they can't be picked up). Loot only.
material.kubejs.eo_corrupted.encyclopedi: Shield plating only: blocked melee attackers are sometimes teleported away.
modifier.kubejs.tf_ice_arrows.descriptio: Shoots Twilight Forest ice arrows, which slow and chill what they hit.
modifier.kubejs.tf_ender_swap.descriptio: When an arrow hits a living target you swap places with it.
modifier.kubejs.tf_seeker_arrows.descrip: Arrows home in on nearby targets but deal half damage.
modifier.kubejs.tf_triple_shot.descripti: Fires two extra, slower arrows angled up and down. Only one arrow is used; the extra ones can't be picked up.
modifier.kubejs.aether_phoenix_fire.desc: Arrows burn and set what they hit on fire.
modifier.kubejs.eo_corrupted_ward.descri: Blocking a melee attack has a 1 in 4 chance to teleport the attacker away (up to 32 blocks).
item.kubejs.knife.description: A small, quick blade. Works as a GregTech crafting knife (losing durability with each craft) and as a Farmer's Delight knife for the cutting board and harvesting straw.
item.kubejs.butcher_knife.description: A heavy one-handed chopping knife. Butchers animals for extra drops (built-in Looting), works on the cutting board and in Hearth & Harvest sausage recipes, and counts as a butcher knife for Occultism's tallow.
item.kubejs.shovel.description: A plain digging tool, just like a vanilla shovel: digs dirt, sand and gravel; right-click to make paths and douse campfires.
